note.text:
Interpretive guidelines:
 Positive:  Indicates active or latent infection by MTB complex.  May
            also be positive with M. kansasii, M. szulgai and
            M. marinum.  Not positive with BCG therapy.  To
            establish a diagnosis of active disease, correlate with
            clinical and radiographic data.
 Indeterminate:  May occur from excessive levels of gamma interferon,
            heterophil antibodies, anergy or handling issues.  Repeat
            analysis is recommended.
 Negative:  Presumptive negative for active or latent MTB infection.
            False negatives may occasionally be seen with impaired
            immune function or testing too early after exposure.
